verdict.rationale: incident.io documents incident declaration directly from Slack and Microsoft Teams, auto-starting a Teams meeting per incident, and GitHub PR updates in the incident channel, with follow-ups exported as GitHub Issues and changes synced back. Two-way flow is explicit: incident tickets can update the incident when the ticket changes and vice versa, and Asana actions auto-sync. Missing for 10: no evidence naming a Jira integration (the bidirectional ticket sync isn't tied to Jira), no Zoom integration evidence, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
